subject: MTA Paraprofessional and Kids Corner Agreements
overview: The School Committee met in executive session to discuss labor negotiations before returning to open session to approve contract agreements for paraprofessionals and Kids Corner staff.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss negotiations with the Medford Teachers Association for paraprofessionals and Kids Corner, following the introduction of new Director of Communications Will Pipicelli.

items.title: Paraprofessionals Memorandum of Agreement
items.summary: Approved a memorandum of agreement and one-year contract for paraprofessionals.

items.title: Kids Corner Memorandum of Agreement
items.summary: Approved a memorandum of agreement for Kids Corner covering four contract years across a one-year and a three-year agreement.
